name: answer-then-land
note: The arc `send <text>` drives, made guardable at budget 0 (C10 F2): act 0 reports needs_input and the engine pauses ‹needs-⬡ question› carrying the question; act 1 is the resumed turn the answer fires, and it reports done. Until this scenario the console's most consequential verb was proven on real bytes alone. It is also the first faithful report on the wire — `streamsReport` puts the closing pair in the stream as well as the transcript, which is where real claude has always put it (C13 F2).
